# [Routing] fix: CSP nonce generation for Edge Runtime

- Replace Node.js crypto.randomBytes with Web Crypto API
  (crypto.getRandomValues) — Edge Runtime compatible
- Use base64url encoding to avoid + and / in nonce values
- Remove incorrect escapeRegex() usage in CSP header values
- Fixes 'nonce-' (empty nonce) CSP errors in production
